evals.prompt: Use the performance skill. Optimize my Next.js site for Core Web Vitals. LCP is 4.2s, CLS is 0.23. Go through images, fonts, layout shifts and content that loads late, and name the metrics you rely on. In this session you have no project files and no shell, and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions: assume a typical Next.js App Router project and answer in text with concrete findings, what you would check, the fixes and the code you would write.
evals.expected_output: Identifies specific LCP and CLS issues and implements targeted fixes
expectations: The answer sets loading="eager" and fetchPriority="high" on the LCP image
The answer adds a sizes attribute to the LCP image
The answer configures AVIF and WebP in images.formats of next.config
The answer uses next/font to self-host the fonts
The answer gives every image explicit width and height or the fill prop
The answer names INP as the interactivity metric next to LCP and CLS
